build_dataset: build a dataset instance for CLIP benchmarking by name with optional transforms and custom templates
build_vtab_dataset: build a VTAB dataset using TensorFlow Datasets and task_adaptation with specified transform and split
build_tfds_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset via timm with automatic download and label extraction
build_wds_dataset: build a WebDataset from tar shards supporting classification and retrieval tasks with optional caching
get_dataset_default_task: get the default evaluation task type for a given dataset name such as zeroshot_classification or retrieval
get_dataset_collate_fn: get the appropriate collate function for a dataset name returning image_captions_collate_fn or default_collate
is_video_dataset: check whether a dataset name corresponds to a video dataset and return a boolean
is_audio_dataset: check whether a dataset name corresponds to an audio dataset and return a boolean
Dummy: create a dummy dataset with two classes returning zero-filled images for quick testing
image_captions_collate_fn: collate a batch of image-caption pairs into batched tensors and a list of text strings
